description: This file contains core repository functions for managing certification jobs, audit logs, metadata, and branch-environment mappings in a certification system. It interacts with a database via SQLAlchemy ORM and leverages external repository adapters to fetch repository metadata.

methods.name: None create_audit_log(session: AsyncSession, action: str, resource_type: str, resource_id: Optional[str], actor: Optional[str], details: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None)
methods.description: Creates an audit log entry for a specified action, resource, actor, and optional details.

methods.name: CertificationJob create_certification_job(session: AsyncSession, req: TriggerCertificationRequest)
methods.description: Creates a new certification job, resolves repository info via adapter, and initializes associated result entries.

methods.name: Optional[CertificationJob] get_certification_job_by_run_id(session: AsyncSession, run_id: str)
methods.description: Retrieves a certification job matching a given run ID.

methods.name: Optional[CertificationJob] patch_certification_job(session: AsyncSession, run_id: str, patch: PatchCertificationRequest)
methods.description: Updates mutable fields of a certification job identified by run ID.

methods.name: List[BranchEnvironmentMapping] list_mappings(session: AsyncSession, provider: Optional[str] = None, project_id: Optional[str] = None)
methods.description: Lists branch-environment mappings, optionally filtered by provider and project ID.

methods.name: BranchEnvironmentMapping create_mapping(session: AsyncSession, item: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Creates a new branch-environment mapping record.

methods.name: List[MetadataItem] list_metadata(session: AsyncSession, filters: Dict[str, Optional[str]])
methods.description: Returns a list of metadata items filtered by optional scope and key.

methods.name: MetadataItem upsert_metadata(session: AsyncSession, payload: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Inserts or updates metadata based on unique key fields.

methods.name: Optional[CertificationJob] update_result_state_by_webhook(session: AsyncSession, run_id: str, cert_type: Optional[CertificationType], state: str, logs_url: Optional[str] = None)
methods.description: Updates certification result statuses based on webhook notifications, supporting various status mappings.
